body.message:
Excuse me, but are you saying that I’m someone who is dirty and doesn’t know how to keep my apartment clean, or have I misunderstood you?

Before making statements like that, please come and check the apartment yourself. I’m 32 years old and I have never had a cockroach problem in my life, except in this building. I have a maid who comes to clean every Friday, and I clean the apartment every day.

There are no food leftovers in the kitchen, as you seem to be suggesting, especially since there is no gas in the apartment to cook with — something that, by the way, was never mentioned to me when I rented the apartment.
